Each step builds upon the previous, showing a progressive design transformation from site footprint (step 1) through massing, solar orientation, circulation, facade articulation, to final inhabited design (step 6). Read left-to-right, top-to-bottom.

Curved black arrows between steps indicate design moves (folding, rotating). The progressive narrative from 2D footprint to fully articulated 3D massing is a signature diagrammatic convention. Clean isometric projection maintained consistently across all steps.
